Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

A boy falls to his death at school, but Ok Chan-mi does not believe that her twin brother, Park Won-seok, committed suicide. Chan-mi transfers to her brother's school, Yongtan High, and meets Ji Soo-heon, who witnessed her brother's death. A "hero," who avenges bullied students, appears at Yongtan High. Chan-mi speculates that it may be connected to her brother and starts looking for this hero.

With little on her resume but full of passion, Park Yoonjo manages to get hired by a top company through an unbiased recruitment project. Proving her value at work is hard, but she powers through life with her old friend and colleague Ryu Jaemin, role model Goo Yijung, and best supporter Seo Donghoon.
A veteran detective who is about to retire unfolds a breathtaking psychological warfare with a mysterious man who follows his path while hiding his identity.
Ten years after discovering her murdered uncle, Ena and Detective Hansaem must cooperate to stop a series of similar murders - each linked by strange puzzle pieces.
Children who live in hiding with superpowers, along with their parents who live with painful secrets of the past, face enormous dangers together.

A secret project in Korea is exposed to the US so the project gets scrapped and the sample is to be handed over when a delivery accident occurs. Director Choe tries to hide the sample as Paul searches, but they end up at the same place as Jagyeong and Lim Sang. Who will seize the sample in the end?
Driven to turn his country's fortunes around, Kim San crosses paths with Pak Doochill, a shady fixer who adapts quickly to any situation; together, the pair form an uneasy alliance.

Kim Ji-yong leads a double life as a Korean National Police University student by day and the Vigilante by night, personally punishing criminals who evade the law. He is surrounded by people who all possess different ulterior motives.

On the night of her wedding, Tari suddenly gets served with an agreement from her husband, Bian, stating that their marriage will end after only a year. Bian, whose heart is faithful to his long-term girlfriend Sarah, had only agreed to their arranged marriage to appease his parents' wishes. Tari attempts to win Bian's love.

In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

An enduring love story in 1987 Seoul; Young-ro, a female university student, treats the bleeding Soo-ho, a student attending a prestigious university, who one day jumps into a women's university dormitory despite the dangerous situation.
A hotel's night manager is the only weapon against a dangerous arms dealer. Will he be able to stop him?

No Go Jin is the most popular mathematics instructor in the private education field and the CEO of GOTOP Education. Even though he has only a high school level education, he has achieved all of his success due to his extreme intelligence. He seems like a perfect man with a handsome appearance, high IQ, and wealth. He is also narcissistic. One day, he is suddenly warned that he will be murdered.

Lee Shin A works as No Go Jin’s secretary. She is a diligent and responsible employee. Due to her quiet and introverted personality, she has little presence with her boss No Go Jin and her colleagues at work. Her colleagues begin to recognize her, because she has worked for the notorious No Go Jin for more than 1 year. She then learns that she does not have much time left to live.
A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

After diving down a rabbit hole of tangled leads, a former bodyguard finds himself recruited to protect the CEO of a controversial lab-grown meat company who is also a survivor of the fateful attack that changed his life.

Yoji Minamimaru, known as Nanmaru, is a university student with a supernatural ability to create small holes in anything. One day, Yoji finds out that the professor of folklore studies has gone missing. Together with his classmates, he decides to search for the professor.

When Jaehee, a top call girl at a club in Gangnam, goes missing, Detective Kang Dongwoo returns to crack the case. Prosecutor Min Seojin aims to rise in rank, while the notorious pimp, Yoon Gilho becomes a prime suspect. They unravel a web of secrets and connections behind the case.

Eun Gye-hoon, a famous chef, opens a restaurant in a town he lived when he was a little kid. In the past, he had a twin sister. But after a traumatic incident tat the hometown, the family lost her. He used to have a strong emotional link to his sister, able to synchronize with any kinds of feelings she was having. When Noh Da-hyun, a young woman in need of help, visits him one day, Gye-hoon starts to feel that strong link again.
A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.
The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

Seo Munju, a highly accomplished diplomat and former ambassador to the United Nations, and Sanho, an international special agent shrouded in a veil of secrets, race to uncover the truth behind an attack that threatens the future stability of the Korean peninsula.
Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

Cha Moosik runs a casino bar, only to flee to the Philippines due to a crackdown by the National Tax Service. He launches a full-fledged casino business, and strategizes winning over the political and business circles in the Philippines. However, he is suddenly framed as a suspect in Min Seokjun's death, and is tracked by Oh Seunghoon of the Korean Desk. Betrayal is rampant in the presence of money.

A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

A psychological thriller that delves into the reality of power. It follows the story of three men and women whose lives are destroyed by a tragic accident as they become a team that uncovers corruption and fights against people with power.
After her husband is brutally murdered by a powerful consort, a grieving woman disguises herself as a physician and infiltrates the imperial city to build an intelligence network and seek revenge.
A high school student suddenly gains supernatural powers that allow him to read people's memories with just one touch. When he reveals his gift, he becomes a detective that solves crime.

A detective infiltrates a notorious prison to investigate disappearances while a retired soldier enters to rescue a mother and daughter, forcing the two enemies to work together against a criminal conspiracy.

A memorial service for Fei Ke brings together female journalist He Shan and four strangers who are invited. They all share undisclosed pasts with Fei Ke, but they discover that the Fei Ke they knew is not the same person. Who is Fei Ke really? As they look back, the group gradually uncovers the truth about Fei Ke.

University student Kuno Totono is the type who constantly questions what is taken for granted in society and develops his own theories based on his vast knowledge and unique set of values. One day in autumn, the police come to see him. His university schoolmate has been murdered at a park nearby and the police apparently regard Totono with suspicion. He is asked to come with them for questioning. In the interrogation room, the police are manipulated by Totono who tends to digress from the topic and poke at their contradictions. He even correctly guesses that one of them is troubled about not getting along with the wife and ends up giving advice. However, Totono’s fingerprints are eventually discovered on the murder weapon.
A quiet office worker reunites with her former high school delinquent classmate, only to discover that his polished new life hides a mysterious secret.

entries.name: AS - The Old Story of Yu Hong (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The Old Story of Yu Hong (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: A series of bizarre, seemingly unrelated murders in a declining industrial town in 1990s Northeast China reveal the intertwined fates of their victims, ultimately uncovering hope and humanity amid brutal survival.
An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

After his family is wiped out by the Tianxiang Sect, Shangguan Chengming goes undercover to take revenge. With the help of Jiang Feiyan, they use a series of scams to expose corruption and fight for justice.
After dying 33 times while trying to win a crown prince's love, a palace maid learns that her fate is tied to a rival prince and joins forces with him to break the cycle.
After moving into her husband's ancestral home to save their marriage, a woman begins uncovering dark secrets when strange events reveal that no one around her is telling the truth.

entries.name: ِAS - Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur (2026) (JP)

streams.name: ِAS - Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur (2026) (JP)

metadata.overview: When 200-year-old human remains discovered in the Himalayas are identified as a perfect DNA match to a missing woman, a complex mystery involving suspicious deaths, lost memories, and hidden truths begins to unfold.

entries.name: AS - Reunion: The Sound of the Providence (2020) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Reunion: The Sound of the Providence (2020) (CN)

metadata.overview: Ten years after their last mission, the famed tomb raiders Wu Xie, Wang Pang Zi, and Zhang Qi Ling have moved on, believing their days of adventure are behind them. Wu Xie, battling a lung illness, receives a mysterious text from his adventurous uncle that prompts him to reunite with his friends. Together, they uncover a perilous world filled with supernatural threats and scheming villains, posing an existential danger to humanity.

In the thriving but crime-ridden city of Shicheng, undercover officer Ling Che reluctantly joins forces with gangster Shen Yanlin. As they pursue the truth behind a series of criminal conspiracies, they uncover corruption, betrayal, and secrets that blur the line between law and crime.

entries.name: AS - Stand Up for Love (Wielka woda) (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Stand Up for Love (Wielka woda) (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: Betrayed and left for dead, a woman returns with a new face and a mysterious ally to dismantle the people who destroyed her life.

After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

entries.name: AS - Tell Me What You Saw (2020) (KR)

streams.name: AS - Tell Me What You Saw (2020) (KR)

metadata.overview: The eccentric Oh Hyun Jae was a peerless criminal profiler until a bomb planted by a serial killer took the life of his young fiancée, causing him to become a recluse. When a serial killer long thought dead returns to terrorize the city, rising star of the police, Hwang Hwa Young, resolves to outwit the killer. To do so, she teams up with both Oh and the remarkable rookie cop Cha Soo Young, whose photographic memory may prove to be a powerful crime-fighting weapon.

An unpredictable romance web drama with a story about a Hallyu star, who is hiding a big secret, meets a reporter from the entertainment department, who risked her life for exclusive news. There is a man who turns into a boy when he touches a female. However, he is a famous Hallyu superstar who always is exposed to the public and has no choice but to lie involuntarily in front of his fans. But then, he meets a woman who finds out about his secret. Communication creates empathy, and empathy can heal one’s heart. How will this encounter affect them and their life?

Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.
An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

A ginseng-hunting trip in the Greater Khingan Mountains ends in tragedy, prompting Liu Laoshuan to seek the help of veteran hunter Ma Sanye, who was driven out of the village years earlier. Soon after Ma's return, a series of unexplained deaths and unsettling incidents plunge the isolated community into fear. As Ma investigates, he uncovers a conspiracy tied to a decade-old secret.

Ji Xing, a technical talent who works diligently in a technology company, resigned resolutely in order to realize her dream and embarked on the road of entrepreneurship. The team formed by Ji Xing and her younger brother was in jeopardy at the beginning of the business. Just when there was no hope, Ji Xing won the support of Han Ting, President of Dongyang Technology, with his unique insights. With Han Ting's investment, the startup Xingchen is finally on the right track. But Ji Xing "lost" her first boyfriend who she had been in love with for seven years. The difficulties of starting a business and the pain of breaking up with her love almost destroyed her. Fortunately, she has the close protection of the sister group.

Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

After being murdered at her own wedding by those closest to her, a top influencer becomes trapped in an endless time loop. With each resurrection, she uncovers more of the conspiracy and joins forces with a doctor who remembers the loops to prevent the tragedy before it happens.
Four young men come to the rescue of a former classmate whose family has been sucked into the clutches of a religious cult and its charismatic leader.

Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

entries.name: AS - The First Sight of Nanyang Overseas Chinese (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The First Sight of Nanyang Overseas Chinese (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: After surviving a wartime bombing in 1941, overseas Chinese volunteer driver Lin Yaozu is mysteriously transported to 2025. As he shares the untold sacrifices of the Nanyang volunteer drivers with Song Yao and others, his journey across time reconnects modern youth with the enduring patriotism and legacy of overseas Chinese during the war.

During World War II, photographer Chen Kailai unexpectedly becomes involved in an underground resistance mission to stop the Japanese army’s secret biological experiment. Taking up his fallen mentor’s codename, he joins fellow spies in a perilous fight to expose the enemy’s crimes and prevent a viral catastrophe.

After discovering Hell University, a group of friends is forced into a lawless school where murder is allowed every night. As fear threatens to break them apart, Zein fights to keep her friends alive while uncovering a system designed to make no one leave.

entries.name: AS - The Affair Was Just The Beginning (2026) (KR)

streams.name: AS - The Affair Was Just The Beginning (2026) (KR)

metadata.overview: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.

After witnessing a murder, famous actress, Wen Jianan, is framed for a deadly accident and stripped of everything she has. As she joins forces with Jiang Yu, a man seeking revenge, they uncover a conspiracy that binds their families together.

After being falsely accused of a scandal that ruins her reputation, noblewoman Fu Tingyun escapes with the help of salt smuggler Zhao Ling. Together, they expose government corruption and navigate the treacherous world of court politics. As they seek justice and uncover the truth behind her past, their bond deepens, leading them to a new beginning.

Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?
After divorcing, Li Zhongyuan and Yuan Shengnan hide the truth from their families while pursuing new relationships that lead them to question whether ending their marriage was the right decision.

After traveling back to 1995, modern woman Zhuang Manying uses her contemporary skills to reshape her mother’s fate, rise in the workplace, and confront a deceitful ex—only to unexpectedly become entangled in a complicated romance with her cold, distant uncle.
Five interconnected stories examine the emotional struggles of ordinary people as they face revenge, loss, identity, unwavering devotion, and the challenges of mental health.
Dumped by her boyfriend of 15 years for gaining weight, a lawyer gets help from a hotshot personal trainer to get in shape and turn her life around.

Shen Yuqing, a mistreated noblewoman’s daughter, assumes a new identity to seek revenge and expose political conspiracies. With the help of Regent Prince Pei Ji, they battle powerful enemies, face deadly trials, and protect their family.

Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu are brought together by a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game. In the scripted NPC game filled with falling snow and spies in the shadows, the two ignite a fateful spark. An unexpected reunion in the real world reveals the mystery of each other's identities. The two shuttle between the misaligned time-spaces of reality and the script, and finally achieve two-way growth in the cross-dimensional bond, completing the transformation of love and self.

Nanotechnology researcher Wang Miao is taken to the Joint Operations Center by police officer Shi Qiang, who's investigating the mysterious suicide wave among scientists worldwide.  He is recruited to sneak into an organization called the Frontiers of Science to help the investigation. When Wang Miao is contacted by the leader of the organization, Shen Yufei, she introduces him to a sophisticated VR video game called Three-Body, but soon he discovers that it's more than just a game.

In the volatile world of martial arts, the cunning young master Mu Qingyan meets the easygoing heroine Cai Zhao, sparking an intense and complex romance. Together, they confront hidden truths and rivalries within the martial world, navigating twists, betrayals, and strategic battles. Their journey paints a vibrant portrait of loyalty, love, and the fierce spirit of heroism.

A missing person case forces three girls from different walks of life to face life-altering choices, exposing the ups and downs of an ordinary family. The story intertwines the light and dark sides of the city—above ground and in the underground tunnels. As one girl navigates these challenges alone, she uncovers the truth, finds redemption, and moves toward a hopeful future.

Brigade Commander Xu Lingjun is assigned to lead a military transformation pilot program. Despite challenges, he trusts Battalion Commander Guo Zijian, who proves himself after a past training accident. In a crucial exercise against an undefeated opponent, they use their innovative tactics to turn the tide.

In the Kunlun martial arts sect, a low-ranking disciple, Peng Dasheng, seeks to uncover the truth behind his father’s death. Teaming up with talented allies, he works to rise through the ranks, expose dark conspiracies, and transform the sect.
A genius girl and her childhood sweetheart navigate life's challenges from campus to marriage in this heartwarming coming-of-age story filled with wit, warmth and youthful passion.

A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

The bullied "three no girls" and the cynical second-generation school bully live in two very different families. A soul exchange made them realize that the other party seemed to be able to live life as they dreamed easily!

Dreaming of filmmaking, a passionate high schooler pushes aside all obligations to create short films, inspiring a studious but passionless classmate. Their deep bond eventually turns romantic, but they are abruptly separated when he is forced to move overseas. Years later in their thirties, their lives have completely swapped: she is a disillusioned, struggling TV reporter, while he has become an award-winning director. When a sudden reunion brings them face-to-face, he resolves to help her rediscover her lost spark, but she still harbors deep resentment over his past disappearance.

A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.
When fame becomes a burden and criticism leaves wounds, crossing paths with this tutoring guy… will it be a lesson, or a test of the heart?

The two amnesiac youths, Yue Jinzhao and Yue Qi, have been wandering the land in search of their identities and pasts, only for Yue Qi to lose all of her money to a member of the Risen Soul Cult. In the process of trying to recover the lost money, they meet up with Luo Zhouyan, the head of the "Evanescent" Luo family who is spearheading efforts in her region to destroy the cult and expose its crimes. As the Yue siblings and Luo Zhaoyan join forces with each other and members of the True Martial Alliance: Ju Shifang, Ming Xin, and her uncle Xian Qing, to root out the leaders of the cult while overcoming their personal demons and finding out about the mysterious organizations operating in the shadows.

Li Xiaoyao, a young inn attendant who dreams of becoming a great hero, accidentally meets Zhao Ling'er, a descendant of the goddess Nuwa. Together, they embark on a quest to find the Water Spiritual Bead, which can end the drought plaguing the land. Along the way, they befriend the bickering partner Lin Yueru and the scholarly Liu Jinyuan, among other like-minded companions. They face numerous dangers in their search for the spiritual bead and ultimately thwart the cataclysmic scheme of the Moon Worship Sect's leader, who aims to destroy the world.

It’s the 19th Century and as western influences spread across Asia, Korea’s Joseon dynasty is experiencing great upheaval and rapid modernization. As the son of the last great swordsman, Park Yoon Kang is caught between two worlds, but the sudden murder of his father and sister catapult him into the new era as he takes up the gun to avenge their deaths. However, it’s not just his family who needs his protection, but his people as well. Is Park Yoon Kang cut out to be the hero of an era?

Sang-Tae is left with his two children after his wife passes away. Since that time, he lives with his two kids and parents-in-law. He works as a marketing team leader for a fashion brand.

Mi-Jung works as an assistant manager at the same fashion company. 3 years ago, her husband had an affair with her friend and left her. She couldn't tell her kids the truth about their father and lied that their father went to work in America. To this day, the children still believe that their father is in America.

Sang-Tae and Mi-Jung never thought about falling in love again, but they fall in love with each other.

This tells the story of Fang Yinuo, a beautiful and simple man, who married his first love, Xiao Lu, with nothing on his hands. Unexpectedly, his proud marriage hit the rocks when his daughter was just one year old. Fang Yinuo resolutely took her daughter from the divorce and started a new life. Two years later, he and Xie Tianhua, who had a crush on him for many years, rekindle their memories and formed a family again.

In Republican Shanghai, Murong Qingyi, a warlord’s son swapped at birth, endures years of torment. His life changes when Ren Susu saves him, but tragedy strikes her family because of it. Years later, love sparks between them, but Ren Susu fakes her death to save another, leaving Qingyi heartbroken. Three years on, she returns as his future sister-in-law. Love, hate, betrayal, and old wounds resurface. As war looms, the two must defy fate together, but can love survive a nation’s fall?

To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.
In a corrupt world, a low-ranking official named Song Jiang rises to fight for justice, uniting 108 outcasts under his banner to challenge the oppressive state in a desperate rebellion.

While investigating her sister’s murder, Su Yunan infiltrates a glittering underworld and is drawn into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng, where every alliance is built on lies and bloodshed.

Prince Rawi, forced into a loveless marriage, is betrayed by his wife’s affair and her deadly plot against him. After falling into an abyss during the confrontation, he wakes with amnesia in a village, starting a new life as Tawan under Lukjan’s care.
When a modern surgeon's soul is cast into a hated 17th-century troublemaker, he uses advanced medicine to save lives and win over his fierce rival.

After his family is wiped out and his memories lost, gifted physician Yang Yunfan arrives in Qijiang City seeking a new beginning. Drawn into the rivalries of the powerful Xuan Medical Association, he must navigate dangerous conspiracies, complicated relationships, and hidden secrets as he searches for the truth about his past.

After being defeated in a war against an invading kingdom, the Prince of Qi had his military power removed. His brother, the Prince of Yun decided to make use of the chance to support the ascension of the young Emperor. Prince Qi came to a tacit agreement with the Emperor and decided to retreat from courtly affairs. Meanwhile, he embarked on a search for the truth in secret under the alias of Pei Zhao. On his journey, he meets young detective Su Ci, the young master Xie Bei Ming, and poison master Dong Ru Shuang. As the four teams up to solve a series of mysteries, they also discover each other’s and their own secrets

Detective Chu Feng investigates the murder of a woman whose body is discovered in a river. As the case unfolds, a series of seemingly unrelated crimes reveal a hidden pattern connecting multiple victims. With a brutal massacre raising the stakes, Chu Feng must hunt down a cunning killer who continues to evade capture.

Judged as a mistress’s daughter, a young woman fights a stigma she never chose. Meanwhile, another woman’s life stands still after her husband's betrayal. Bound together by the death of the man who tore their lives apart, these two apparent enemies are forced to confront one another under one roof. As families scarred by hatred and heartbreak collide, old wounds resurface. Facing years of prejudice, they set out to reclaim their lives and transform their bitter fate into an unexpected family bond.

A struggling couple accidentally moves into a lavish mansion and discovers a hidden fortune. But as unexpected troubles follow, they begin to question whether their sudden luck is a blessing or a curse.

Shen Yaochu is forced into a marriage with General Li Jingchuan, believed to be dead, only to discover he’s alive. After her mother’s tragic death, Shen Yaochu and Li Jingchuan join forces to unravel conspiracies and hidden plots within the Shen family, discovering trust and love along the way.

Deputy captain Li Kaiyang and his apprentice Jiang Han investigate a series of brutal murders, including sexual assault cases and mysterious nude corpse killings. When the supposedly dead “Red Gloves” killer appears to return, the two detectives race to uncover a long-hidden mystery connected to the crimes.

Three years ago, math prodigy Rao Yuci was framed by her best friend, Bai Liangliang, and sent to a treatment center. While Rao Yuci lost everything, Bai Liangliang climbed the corporate ladder. Now, fully recovered, Rao Yuci is determined to expose Bai Liangliang's deceit and make her pay for the betrayal.

It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. Yang's family rushes back to the village to strategize for Xiaofang. The Qi and Yang families have completely different attitudes, unexpectedly sparking a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families fail, Xiaofang starts "blind dates while pregnant" — and surprisingly finds herself courted by the whole village, setting off a series of hilarious and laugh-out-loud events.

تنقلب حياة "سوي مونو" رأساً على عقب إثر فحص طبي روتيني يكشف عن إصابتها بالعقم، مما يؤدي إلى انفصال حبيبها عنها بعد علاقة دامت سبع سنوات. وسرعان ما تراه يغازل زميلة أخرى في العمل، وتنتشر شائعات حول حالتها الصحية في أرجاء الشركة، الأمر الذي يدفعها لتقديم استقالتها. وفي محاولة لرفع معنوياتها، تُعرّفها صديقتها على "ماو تسوكيدومي"، وهو شاب وسيم يصغرها سناً؛ إذ يتميز "ماو" بطباعه الطيبة واللطيفة، ويُبدي اهتماماً صادقاً بـ "سوي" في وقت كانت تعاني فيه من تدنٍ شديد في ثقتها بنفسها. ينجح "ماو" في انتشالها من أحزانها، وتصبح "سوي" مستعدة للمضي قدماً في حياتها. لكنها تُصاب بالذهول عند بدء عملها الجديد وانتقالها إلى مسكنها الجديد، حين تكتشف أن "ماو" هو جارها الجديد. فهل ستتمكن "سوي" من بدء حياة جديدة ومرحلة عاطفية جديدة؟

entries.name: AS - Key to the Phoenix Heart (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Key to the Phoenix Heart (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.

Lian Maner, a modern girl, accidentally finds herself in an ancient rural village where she encounters the eccentric Lian family, who are her distant relatives. She also meets the enigmatic and "tsundere" male lead, Shen Nuo. Together, they confront troublesome relatives, engage in farming and business ventures, and strive for prosperity. As they go through various hilarious and chaotic situations, their relationship deepens, and they promise to accompany each other through life. With chickens flying and dogs jumping, and with the gathering of relatives and the cultivation of rice, everyone is invited to join in the farming journey.

When the Sea Calamity strikes and the Divine Tree appears, whoever claims its fruit gains power over all creation, sparking a bloody war among the immortals, demons, and monsters. A century later, Lei Xiuyuan seeks out Qingqiu orphan Xiaobangchui to save his brother. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give her warmth and love begins to bloom. As their bond deepens from friendship to something more, the truth of her origins slowly unravels, threatening everything they've built.

Healer A Zhao, a descendant of a goddess from the Wuyue Clan, falls in love with Ying Du, the ruler of the Puluo Kingdom, only to witness him massacre her clan and become bound to him across three lifetimes by a time-reversing bracelet. As A Zhao uncovers the truth and challenges heavenly law, she fights to break their cursed fate and reclaim their love.

To avenge her childhood friend Gu Chengyu, Mu Jiuyun disguises herself as a princess and marries the iron-faced general Mo Yu. She soon suspects that Mo Yu may be more than he seems, while allies harbor secrets of their own. Caught in a web of deception and hidden identities, Mu Jiuyun must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

Top-tier agent Nan Caiyun and the extremely self-absorbed agent Yan Yingjun pose as a married couple with a fake daughter to infiltrate the world of the elite. As they navigate danger and deception, their pretend family slowly transforms into something real.

In the 1990s, teenagers Chen Yi and Miao Jing met due to their parents, initially getting off to a rocky start. However, Miao Jing's kindness eventually softens Chen Yi's attitude towards her. Chen Yi and Miao Jing's relationship deepens after Chen Yi's father dies and Miao Jing's mother disappears, leaving the two to rely only on each other. Miao Jing eventually confesses her feelings for Chen Yi, but he pushes her away after he gets tangled up as a crime witness, urging her to leave their city. Years later, Chen Yi runs a billiards hall in their hometown, while Miao Jing returns for a work assignment. But when Chen Yi suspects that Miao Jing's boss is involved in smuggling, he vows to protect her – and stay by her side.

Si Yan, a top beauty blogger, is accidentally transported into a VR game set in ancient China, where she starts as a lowly maid. Armed with her modern makeup skills and savvy communication, she quickly rises to fame, helping women express themselves through beauty while uncovering their personal stories. Though determined to avoid romance, she finds herself drawn into an unexpected love journey with several charming characters, blending humor, emotion, and romance in a fantastical world.

When Lin Wanxing returns to her hometown and takes a job at a local high school, she’s unexpectedly tasked with reviving its long-disbanded soccer team. With help from her mysterious tenant, former coach Wang Fa, they work to rebuild the team, guide the students toward their dreams, and face the shadows of their own pasts along the way.

entries.name: AS - How to Train Your Killer (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - How to Train Your Killer (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: On her wedding night, Crown Princess Gu Qingyao unexpectedly swaps souls with the assassin Shi Yi during an attempt on her husband’s life. Forced into a deadly game of deception and strategy, she fights to protect the crown prince while uncovering a far-reaching conspiracy that connects the imperial court with the martial world.

entries.name: AS - Let's End Our Friendship Now (2026) (JP)

streams.name: AS - Let's End Our Friendship Now (2026) (JP)

metadata.overview: At 27, Himari Shibasaki and Kazumi Hojo have been inseparable since college, but a drunken confession about Himari’s romantic insecurities completely transforms the boundaries of their friendship. What begins as a physical arrangement born from mutual loneliness quickly evolves into more, as neither of them is sure if their romantic feelings are reciprocated. Kazumi, haunted by a traumatic childhood, has secretly loved Himari, who he believes saved him from his own hollowness. Meanwhile, Himari struggles to drop the "perfect girl" persona she uses to mask her own past grief. As they navigate the transition from friends-with-benefits to a committed couple, their fragile peace is threatened by a jealous coworker and a dangerous stalker from Himari’s past, leading to a potentially dangerous situation.

Rain-soaked night murder attempt unravels when father-daughter detectives Lao He and He Ying, grappling with impending retirement and fractured familial bonds, confront a case entangled with their past as suspects lead to the shadowy secrets of the Han Dong couple they once knew.

entries.name: AS - The Sword and the Brocade (2021) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The Sword and the Brocade (2021) (CN)

metadata.overview: Despite being born with low status, Luo Shiyiniang is extremely assertive and believes that a woman's vision should not be limited to the household. She hopes to rely on her embroidery skills as a ticket to freedom. However, the once-esteemed Luo family is in a state of decline. Hoping to save the clan through a marriage alliance, Shiyiniang is selected to become the wife of Yongping Duke and great general Xu Lingyi. Things were not easy for Shiyiniang due to the Xu family's biases towards her. Nonetheless, she manages to win their trust through her optimism and sincerity. Xu Lingyi also becomes attracted to Shiyiniang's various beautiful qualities such that husband and wife find love after marriage.

Tan Jing (Li Xiao Ran), a devoted single mother, struggles to care for her son Sun Ping (Mi Ke), who suffers from a congenital heart disease. Despite financial hardships, she remains positive and resilient. Doctor Nie Yu Sheng (Wallace Chung), dedicated to helping children with heart conditions, selects Sun Ping as his first patient for a groundbreaking surgery project. Their reunion reveals they were once lovers, sparking unexpected emotions. As Sun Ping undergoes treatment, Tan Jing and Yu Sheng navigate their complicated past and potential future together.

"Legend of Zang Hai" follows the son of Imperial Astronomer Kuai Duo. Consumed by vengeance, he spends a decade honing his skills. Assuming the name Zang Hai, he ventures into the capital to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and restore justice.

entries.name: AS- The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO (2026) (JP)

streams.name: AS- The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO (2026) (JP)

metadata.overview:
Hanai Shiori, who works in the sales department of a fashion distribution website, is suddenly dumped by her boyfriend Keiichi on their third anniversary. While she is in tears at a bar, a kind man approaches and gently speaks to her. Leaning on his kindness, Shiori ends up spending the night with him.

As time passes, Shiori discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters more complicated, the new company president who appears at her workplace turns out to be the very man from that night.

entries.name: AS - The Legend of Rosy Clouds (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The Legend of Rosy Clouds (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: In the legendary Nine Cities, noblewoman Fan Yun and cunning lord Qi Zheng join forces to overcome a looming crisis. As they fight for the people's welfare, their bond deepens into friendship and love to bring peace and prosperity to the realm.

Qian Fei, an employee in a bank, was planning a fulfilling life. But after being abandoned by her fiancé, she had to redefine her life. Li Yifei, from a rich family, always prioritized his career. His girlfriend couldn't endure poverty and left. To cover her mortgage, Fei rent out a room to Yifei, and they became collaborators. Fei bravely faced challenges and grew through the process. Their journey was marked by collisions, but they fell in love and decided to face the future together.

Li Wenxiu, a Han Chinese girl who grew up in Altay, is determined to pursue her literary dream in a big city. However, she repeatedly encounters obstacles and is forced to return to her hometown to rely on her mother who runs a small shop. After meeting Kazakh boy Batay, Wenxiu gradually discovered the beauty of the local area.

Eldest daughter Ye Li marries the crippled Prince Mo Xiuyao, while her sister Ye Ying weds Prince Mo Jinglei the same day. A descendant of Lishan, Ye Li secretly seeks revenge on those who wronged her clan. Suspected by her husband, who also hides a revenge plan, the couple gradually become allies. Meanwhile, Prince Jinglei plots to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li and Mo Xiuyao join forces to defeat their enemies and restore peace to the empire.

Retired ballet artist Tan Siting returns to China, wanting to seek a second chance with Feng Rui, the lover she was once forced to leave behind. But past misunderstandings have built a wall between them. Feng Rui's orderly life as a a single father is thrown into chaos by her reappearance. Meanwhile, Tan Siting is accompanied by a man who has loved her from afar for a decade. As Tan Siting and Feng Rui try to avoid each other, fate keeps forcing them together, leaving them trapped in a turbulent mix of love and heartache.
Years after two college sweethearts went their separate ways, Mosheng and Yichen rekindle their romance despite a barrage of challenges to their love.
A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

A thrice-widowed woman marries Ye Lang, the illegitimate son of a powerful tycoon, believing she’s found a sincere younger lover—only to be drawn into a hidden scheme. Reborn after dying on his wedding day in a past life, Ye Lang returns seeking revenge, but finds himself entangled in her charm once again. As love and suspicion collide, deeper secrets surface, revealing that someone else may be manipulating everything from behind the scenes.

At Mirage City's 444 Convenience Store, Xia Dongqing and Ya join forces with a cryptic Night Watcher to maintain the balance between realms—until a crimson moon exposes a hidden conspiracy. Though peace returns, new anomalies stir in the shadows.

entries.name: AS - The Legend of Kitchen Soldier (2026) (KR)

streams.name: AS - The Legend of Kitchen Soldier (2026) (KR)

metadata.overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

An arrest operation that both succeeds and fails changes everyone's fate. Waiting in agony means never giving up, and those unspeakable crimes are also waiting for an opportunity to return. This time, it is the final battle between good and evil!

After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.
A young detective is reassigned to media relations, uncovering the drama and secrets behind the headlines while helping solve crimes.

After her family is massacred, artisan’s daughter Nan Yanzhi becomes the disciple of Zhuang Wujiao, who trains her to survive in a ruthless world. Determined to uncover the truth and avenge her family, she infiltrates the deadly Lingya Tower, where entrants are forced into brutal combat and none are said to return, only to discover that her own master holds power within the very place she came to destroy.

After a family emergency, Qing Ye returned to her hometown in her senior year of high school. Finding it difficult to adjust after spending most of her life in a bustling city, Qing Ye vows to leave as soon as she gets a chance. But when she meets Xing Wu, a local teen who's struggling with school, she resolves to help him graduate. Gradually, Xing Wu and Qing Ye grow closer to each other, despite their different personalities and priorities in life. Upon graduating high school, Qing Ye moves away for university, but ends up returning years later – and so does Xing Wu, who still has feelings for Qing Ye. Will this second chance give them a chance to finally realize their feelings for each other?

Lin Xingran, a young doctor, returns home to investigate her mother’s murder. Disguised as a family physician, she infiltrates the household of Master Fang, a wealthy suspect, but becomes the prime suspect herself after his sudden death. When Jiang Beichen, her former lover and now the lead investigator, takes on the case, old tensions reignite. As they uncover the truth together, a shocking discovery turns their world upside down.

Three seemingly ordinary but deadly uncles, whose fate sets them in motion again. It depicts the everyday lives of three middle-aged men, who have lived 50% of their lives, and the realistic comedy of these uncles who are even sadder because they were successful in their past.
When a student unearths the truth behind his grandfather’s life, he must unveil his secret superpowers to an underworld eager for his emergence.

entries.name: AS - Love in Flames of War (2022) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Love in Flames of War (2022) (CN)

metadata.overview: During the period of the Republic of China, the cardamom talented girl Lin Hangjing was imprisoned because of her father’s murder. She went to her father’s friend Xiao Dashuai. Although she was under the fence, she was not humble or overbearing. Xiao Beichen, the overbearing three young master of the Xiao family, had bullied her from the very beginning to gradually attracted by her strong independence.

As soon as Zhu Yun started college life, the world was completely turned upside down by the intrusion of "bad boy" Li Xun. He was regarded by Zhu Yun as a rich, ignorant and incompetent son, but his real identity was actually a special admissions student who was admitted by the school, and a rare programming genius. After several confrontations, the two have some appreciation for each other. The senior Fang Zhijing made things difficult for Zhu Yun many times, Li Xun took action to protect Zhu Yun, and invited her to join the preparation team he set up to win a major programming competition on behalf of the school.

In 1997, a disappearance inside an elevator pulls detectives He Yuanhang and Ran Fangxu into a twisted mystery. Facing doubt and confusion along the way, they press on to uncover the truth. As time moves on, they heal from life's uncertainties, hold fast to justice, and rise above hardship with resilience and hope.

A tribute ink scandal topples the Li family’s long-standing ink business, leaving their legacy in ruins. Years later, Li Zhen, the determined youngest daughter, sets out to restore her family's name. As she rises in the industry, she joins forces with Luo Wenqian, heir to another fallen clan, to take on a rising rival and face new challenges from foreign markets, fighting to bring Huizhou ink back to its former glory.

In the eyes of outsiders, Su Yu Ning almost has a perfect life: a thriving career, a gentle husband and a well-behaved daughter. Unexpectedly, this wonderful life fell apart overnight. First her husband cheated, and then her daughter was injured and unconscious. Soon, Su Yu Ning discovers, that's she's was already part of and in the midst of a calculated conspiracy. And what was entrenched, in the center of the conspiracy was the person she never expected. In order to protect her daughter, Su Yu Ning had to stand up and declare war on "her".

To save his critically ill daughter, Luo Xiao is forced into the criminal underworld by a gang leader. After taking over an illegal money-laundering operation, he becomes the target of a relentless police investigation that uncovers a larger conspiracy involving murder, corruption, and underground finance.

entries.name: AS - Across the Ocean to See You (2017) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Across the Ocean to See You (2017) (CN)

metadata.overview: After her divorce, Su Mang returns to China as the CEO of a tourism company branch, where she clashes with hotel expert Zhang Chu due to a misunderstanding. Her tough leadership sparks workplace gossip about her failed marriage, but Zhang Chu steps in to help, gradually changing their dynamic in unexpected ways.

In 1931, due to betrayal by traitors, the party's underground organization in Shanghai was severely damaged, and the revolutionary cause fell into white terror. Ma Tian Mu, a young party member who was injured in the Northern Expedition was ordered to go to France. Under the guidance of his superior Wu Zhong Xin and the cooperation of comrades, he walked among all kinds of bureaucratic gentry and police gangs.
The story of a veterinarian killer who saves animals and a detective who saves people.

Set in post-revolution China, the He family faces challenges after the passing of their father, He Changsheng. With six daughters navigating love, work, and life’s ups and downs, their shared strength and unity help them uncover the true meaning of family.

After a mysterious accident, Xiao Ning finds himself transported into another world as the live-in son-in-law of the powerful Su family. Using ancient techniques to revolutionize tea and wine, he uses his sharp wit and strategies to quickly rise to prominence.

Zhang Yi'ang, a veteran detective, is sent to Sanjiangkou to investigate a case but soon finds himself caught in a web of crime and corruption. While pursuing a powerful criminal network, he unexpectedly receives help from a group of bungling thieves, who inadvertently aid his mission to unravel the truth behind a murder.

Lin Zhanqiao, a successful and independent woman, avoids settling for less in love, seeking a genuine connection. After meeting He Han, initial misunderstandings give way to mutual growth in love and career, leading them to realize they are perfect for each other. As they overcome challenges and prepare for marriage, they rediscover the true meaning of love and marriage.

Disguised as another man, Crown Prince Yin Zhou infiltrates a powerful family to conduct a secret investigation, where he encounters Gu Yuluo, who seeks to uncover her own past. As their conflicting agendas collide, they form an uneasy alliance and navigate a world of deception, power, and life-or-death choices.

While investigating the truth behind a powerful family, determined blogger Wen Yan unexpectedly crosses paths with cold and reserved CEO Lu Tingxiao. As she becomes entangled in his world, their uneasy encounters give way to a forbidden romance that begins to uncover hidden secrets, testing the boundaries between ambition, power, and genuine love.
A heartwarming tale follows three sisters from Kashgar's ancient city as they navigate love, family bonds, and life's storms together, rebuilding their lives with resilience and hope.

entries.name: AS - A Lover in the Mortal World (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - A Lover in the Mortal World (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: Amidst war and chaos, Han Yunling, a young female doctor, emerges to save lives while uncovering secrets of her tragic past. With the help of General Xiao Chi, their bond deepens as she tries to clear her family’s name and bring peace to the nation.

A medical team from the mainland of China arrived at an island in the South Pacific Ocean in order to complete their mission. But they were met with a rare natural disaster. Thus, their race against time begins as they try to complete their rescue mission. But, not only do they need to complete their rescue mission, they'll soon reveal a sinister plot underneath the surface.

entries.name: AS - My Roommate Is a Gumiho (2021) (KR)

streams.name: AS - My Roommate Is a Gumiho (2021) (KR)

metadata.overview: To become a human, a 999-year-old Gumiho, Shin Woo-yeo needs to fill his fox bead with human energy before he turns 1,000 years old. One day, a college girl, Lee Dam accidentally swallows Woo-yeo's fox bead.
Han Ji-hyuk, an NIS agent gone MIA, returns after one year to join a new team as he searches for his lost past.

To break a powerful curse and save his clan, Lu Qianqiao is reborn as a human and secretly marries Xin Mei, a gifted cultivator with a fated curse. What starts as a mission of survival soon entangles them in betrayal, memory loss, and growing affection as they face deadly trials and uncover their intertwined destinies.

Dentist Ai Jingchu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li’s mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jingchu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse.

Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

In 2012, the mysterious death of Dr. Leng Wenyu brings together detective An Ying, forensic expert Leng Wenqi, and journalist Xiao Chen. Five years later, as they investigate a series of suspicious deaths, the trio uncovers the truth behind Leng Wenyu’s demise.

General Li Shuang of Taijin finds a man who has lost his memory and names him Jin'an. Jin'an devotes himself to accompanying Li Shuang; however, as he gradually regains his memories, he discovers that he is actually a prince from an enemy nation. Once bound by love, the two are forced into battle. Together, they confront challenges that test their loyalties and beliefs, striving to resolve the conflict and uphold the justice they both believe in.

Xu Miyu’s perfect marriage shatters on her 10th anniversary, prompting her to rediscover herself and choose divorce. Starting over as a hotel cleaner at Purong Hotel, she crosses paths with Ji Feng, the hotel’s new GM and her former acquaintance. As they face workplace challenges together, love blossoms, and they transform Purong Hotel into a rising city landmark.

In 1990, underdog Wang Qiang hits rock bottom—jobless, scorned, and abandoned by his wife. Suddenly, he's transported to 2020, now the father of local tycoon Lu Siming. Using his newfound wealth, Wang seizes his chance for revenge and fortune, only to be thrown back to his impoverished life in 1990. With future knowledge, he’s determined to rebuild his life on his own terms.

During the Second Sino-Japanese War, a farmer joins the Eighth Route Army after his father is killed by Japanese collaborators, while his family becomes deeply involved in the resistance. As tragedy strikes, he risks his life by going undercover to help the resistance reclaim their occupied hometown.

A mysterious body by the Tong River resurfaces clues to a five-year-old case, bringing together three childhood friends—now a criminal investigator, a detective, and an undercover agent. As they pursue the truth behind multiple unsolved crimes, they navigate hidden dangers and unravel deep conspiracies.

This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher’s daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher’s knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.

While investigating her best friend’s suicide, single mother Yan Ling is drawn into a dangerous web of emotional manipulation. As love and betrayal become entangled, she begins to recognize the truth, break free from control, and reclaim her life.

After being set up by her company, 36-year-old executive Xia Xiaolan wakes up as her 18-year-old self in a poor village. Determined to change her fate, she pursues education while building a business empire from nothing. Along the way, she finds love, support, and a renewed sense of purpose, proving that courage and determination lead to true success.
This tells the story about a policewoman, Ran Dongdong, who solves the "Big Trap Case" and raises reflections and questions about marriage and love in the process of doing
A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

In the 1980s, Gao Jialin, a young man living in Gaojiagou in northern Shaanxi Province,Gao Jialin was not defeated. He strived to learn new knowledge in accordance with the times, and through the changes of the world, he wrote an extraordinary life story of an ordinary man in the tide of the times.

Unexpected changes bring Zhou Quan and Che Li’s happy ten-year marriage to a standstill, as one is suddenly laid off despite their talent while the other rushes to start a business. Can the two in their thirties get back on track towards a happy life?

A kidnapping case uncovers a decade-old murder hidden in an old phonograph recording. As the investigation reveals shocking secrets, three young people, once full of potential, form an unbreakable bond, facing their dark pasts and protecting each other from fate’s grip.

Rookie office worker Wang Cuihua is suddenly pulled into the world of a novel, where she meets Xiahou Dan, a powerful king hiding his true identity. Both outsiders to this world, they join forces to survive a twisted fate, facing political intrigue, ancient prophecies, and life-or-death choices. As they fight to change their destiny, a powerful bond forms, one that could reshape the future of the kingdom.

Senior prosecutor Duan Hongshan from the city prosecutor's office is tasked with handling a case involving a woman accused of killing her abusive husband. Young prosecutor Fang Lingyuan from the provincial office is assigned to assist. As they investigate, they discover connections to a case from Duan’s past. Guided by facts and legal principles, they navigate complex issues of justice, sentiment, and law to reach an accurate conclusion in the case.

Jiang Li, daughter of the Grand Tutor, often retreats to the secluded Wenxiang Pavilion with her confidante, A Zhao, to avoid an arranged marriage. Forced into a marriage with the Left General, she enters the palace, only to discover that A Zhao is the reigning emperor. From then on, they are deeply entangled in love and palace secrets.

A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?

entries.name: AS - Legend of the Female General (2025) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Legend of the Female General (2025) (CN)

metadata.overview: A female general with a gentle appearance but a strong inner spirit, and a male general with a cold exterior and internal but with stronger martial prowess. The two join forces to combat deceit, assist the weak, and eliminate external threats.

After his new neighbor Su Ran moves into Yuxian County, veteran detective Shi Guangming finds himself pulled back in as a consultant when a string of brutal murders erupts. Teaming up with Li Hao, the current head of the county’s criminal investigation unit, they unravel the case and bring all the culprits to justice.

In the economically developed eastern province of Guangdong, Luoyuan County is a county seat with the lowest public security status, and the flood tide of the era of sweeping and eradicating evil has engulfed it. The young criminal policeman Wu Jian encountered the obstruction of the underworld forces on the way to investigate a shooting case, and the evidence he handed back to the police force disappeared. He could not clear the suspicion, only Wen Luyang resolutely chose to believe in Wu Jian and invited him to cooperate Task Force work. Wen Luyang, who doesn't play cards according to the routine, and the upright guy Wu Jian, who is thick and thin, have formed a pair of case-solving combinations with different styles.

entries.name: AS - Eternal Love of the Fox (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Eternal Love of the Fox (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: Disguised as a palace maid to search for her missing father, Huo Xiangjiu uncovers that the powerful court favorite Feng Mochen is actually a thousand-year-old fox spirit. After an accidental soul swap binds them together, the unlikely pair must solve a string of strange palace cases, gradually uncovering a long-buried secret.

That winter, a horrific crime left veteran police captain Peng Zhaolin deeply shaken. A decade earlier, he had unknowingly crossed paths with the suspect, Deng Ligang, missing a crucial chance to stop the crime spree. Despite a relentless pursuit, the criminals vanished without a trace. Years later, a new clue emerges, prompting Peng Zhaolin and young officer Zhen Zhen to reopen the case and seek justice for the victims.
The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

entries.name: AS - Sharp Blade in the Snow (2026) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Sharp Blade in the Snow (2026) (CN)

metadata.overview: Falsely accused of murdering her father, Princess Feng Li returns from exile as a feared ruler to uncover the truth behind the crime. At a decadent banquet designed to flush out her enemies, she draws close to Yun Zhan, a mysterious slave who is secretly a fallen prince. As their hidden motives collide and political conspiracies close in, Feng Li and Yun Zhan must choose between revenge, power, and the love that threatens to undo them both.

When Huo Ming loses his memory in an accident, a hidden AI chip awakens superhuman abilities within him. Caught in Lin Yun’s corporate battle, he must confront hidden truths, protect those he cares about, and find love, all while redefining who he really is.

Lu Ning enters a virtual world seeking the truth behind her father's murder. To uncover it, she must obtain a chip from Ye Wuming, the Xuanling clan's top assassin, which only materializes during emotional turmoil. However, Lu Ning's virtual identity is Black Lotus—the very figure responsible for Ye Wuming's centuries of suffering.

A noblewoman who becomes a righteous bandit called Gil Dong, and Joseon Prince Yi Yeol who secretly investigates this bandit, only to find their souls mysteriously swapped, forcing them to work together and fall in love amidst intrigue, as they uncover conspiracies while protecting the people!

Explores the complex lives and struggles of people traveling through the Li Cheng train station, highlighting the intense conflict between good and evil with high-stakes action and intrigue throughout a series of thrilling railway anti-pickpocketing cases.

Once a convict, Ji-hwan is now a successful, albeit overly cautious CEO, who has yet to experience any of life’s more enjoyable pleasures: namely falling in love. But all that changes when fate brings beloved children’s content creator Eun-ha into his life. The unlikely pair find love most unexpectedly but Eun-ha’s longtime fan, Prosecutor Hyun-woo isn’t ready to let her go without a fight.

Ding Liaoliao, an enthusiastic TV writer, and Jiang Kan, a reserved pharmacist, unexpectedly become roommates despite their opposite personalities. Their lives become intertwined through work and daily interactions, leading to unexpected bonds. Also living with them are Ding's younger brother and a TV anchor, who are enjoying a blossoming romance. Together, the four navigate humorous and heartwarming moments, facing life's challenges as they grow closer and support each other.

entries.name: AS - The Legend of the Condor Heroes (2017) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The Legend of the Condor Heroes (2017) (CN)

metadata.overview: During the Southern Song dynasty, Guo Jing and Yang Kang, two boys orphaned by war, grow up on opposite paths—one becoming a patriotic hero, the other consumed by ambition and betrayal.

For centuries, humans and demons have battled over the legendary Jade Liquor Spring, a symbol of desire. Free-spirited Xiao Yao unexpectedly enters Ten Thousand Demons Valley, disrupting the demon world. There, she meets the powerful Demon King Hong Ye, who grows to admire her pure heart. Together, they face mysterious cases and formidable enemies, uncovering hidden truths along the way.

In a rapidly developing Hanzhou, police officer Qin Feng and his sworn brother Liu Tianye face off against dangerous criminals while grappling with deep moral dilemmas and the complicated ties between family, power, and justice.

The drama follows the romantic story of Lin Yusen and Nie Xiguang, tracing Nie’s journey from college to the workplace. Bright and optimistic, she experiences an unspoken love in university, then meets Lin Yusen, a former surgeon turned industry professional. Despite early misunderstandings, her warmth draws him in. Through love and support, she overcomes past regrets, grows professionally, and ultimately finds love, fulfillment, and self-discovery.

At the dawn of the prosperous Tang Dynasty, the world was magnificent and full of vitality; yet beneath the dazzling splendor of nighttime Chang’an lurked shadows of sin and desire. Beneath the strange and wondrous surface lay bizarre happenings, and amid blood and turmoil, deadly hunts awaited in secret. Thus begins a tale of mysteries and strange cases in an age of glory.

In 1990s China, Er Pang’s uncle, a brilliant Harbin Institute of Technology graduate, embarks on one ambitious venture after another, driven by his boundless curiosity and talent. Despite the many challenges he faces, he finds strength in the unwavering support of family and friends, using his resilience and optimism to realize his dreams.

After the Gengzi Kingdom changed, the land of China was devastated, and young people with aspirations rose up to save their homeland. Aristocratic youth Liang Xiang, revolutionary party Yang Kaizhi, and Beiyang Wuyou Guardian Li Renjun became the first batch of progressive young people who went to Japan to study at a non-commissioned officer’s school. They met revolutionary exiles Yu Tianbai and Qiu Hong on a cruise ship. Since then, the five people have been fatefully linked.

To uncover the truth behind her sister’s disappearance, medical student Jiang Yuanyue assumes a new identity and infiltrates the influential Zeng family as a maid. Her search leads to the discovery of her sister’s body and exposes the patriarch’s murderous secrets, forcing her and the second young master to confront the family’s darkest truths.

Genius student Lin Dongfeng is recruited by the government to lead a special research team working on controlled nuclear fusion after his online theories gain international attention. As he pushes toward a groundbreaking scientific breakthrough, he must navigate sabotage from competitors, intense internal scrutiny, and the strain it puts on his relationship with his girlfriend Zheng Wanzhi.

After her parents' divorce, Jiang Mu reunites with her adopted brother Jin Chao, now a hardened young man living a dangerous life in Thailand. Despite their growing distance, Jiang Mu's unwavering love helps bridge the gap between them, leading to a journey of healing and redemption as they fight to rebuild their bond and face their struggles together.

Because of a marriage election, girls from all over the world gather in Xinchuan. Yin Zheng, the sixth young master of Xinchuan, and Li Wei, who only wants to lose the election and live comfortably in her hometown, accidentally meet. There, a new interesting and fun chapter of their lives start. As Yin Zheng opens his house and goes to court, the two of them gradually grow closer, and spend everyday through all four seasons together. They grow together with other siblings of different personalities and fates, writing the warm daily life of the Xinchuan family together.

He Ruoxian, Feng Baichuan, and the Shen brothers navigate wartime struggles in finance, espionage, and material transport in Macau during World War II. Though untouched by Japanese occupation, Macau becomes a crucial battleground where they courageously fight for the nation.

After a setback forces urban artist Lu Qingqing to return to her hometown, she unexpectedly meets Yu Xichen, a mysterious “alien visitor.” Their playful misunderstanding turns into a fantastical romance filled with strange incidents and heartfelt protection. As they work with local youths to build a creative utopian community, growing opposition threatens their dream—testing their love through separation, struggle, and fate.

entries.name: AS - The Rise of the Qin Empire (2025) (CN)

streams.name: AS - The Rise of the Qin Empire (2025) (CN)

metadata.overview: After the fall of his homeland and the death of his father in battle, Ying Shuo takes the throne as Qin Wen Gong during a time of crisis. With the court divided, brothers turning against each other, and a doomed romance tangled in national turmoil, he pushes forward with sweeping reforms to transform the struggling western state.

In Republican-era China, Feng Qianqian—a detective trained overseas—returns home and partners with her boyfriend, Inspector Zhang, to investigate the mysterious murder of real-estate tycoon Wang Qiang. As they dig deeper, Feng Qianqian uncovers a web of hidden conspiracies and pursues the truth with unwavering determination.
A perfect crime unravels hidden human darkness as a child-related case emerges, exposing the unsettling truths of society beneath its calm facade.

Su Ruan and Xu Zhongwen remain loyal to each other amid danger and deceit, standing firm against those with ill intentions. As they battle evil and uncover the truth, they learn to confront their pasts, let go of hatred, and courageously step into a new life together.
After a tragic loss shakes his confidence, Zhu Xiao must solve a high-stakes poisoning case to uncover the truth, heal, and reclaim his sense of purpose.

The evolving relationship between Mu Wanqing, a successful CEO, and Liu Qing, a former soldier, who marry first and fall in love later. Initially strangers, their bond deepens as they face challenges together, including family expectations that lead them on a journey to Thailand.

In 1930s Shanghai, detective Guan Cen and university student Lu Yizhen, meet during an investigation into a mysterious death at a women’s dormitory. Two years later, Lu Yizhen becomes one of Shanghai’s first female police officers, working directly under Guan Cen. Together, they reopen an unresolved child kidnapping case, uncovering hidden truths and confronting the shadows of the past.

entries.name: AS - Miss Gu Who is Silent (2020) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Miss Gu Who is Silent (2020) (CN)

metadata.overview: Gu Xingdan changes her name and concealed her identity, and set up a series of plans to help her brother wash away his grieve. However, the situation is already controlled by someone and Gu Xingdan falls into a trap and became someone else's chess piece.
A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

A wrongfully accused scholar, Gu Pingyuan, becomes a fugitive and uses his intelligence to build a commercial empire. Starting as a merchant, he establishes himself in various industries, clashes with different merchant groups, and ultimately aims to save the nation's economy, showcasing a generation of merchants who served their country through commerce.

entries.name: AS - Warm on a Cold Night (2023) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Warm on a Cold Night (2023) (CN)

metadata.overview: Su Jiu'er, a female constable of the Qian country who is scared of cold, and Han Zheng, the warm young master of the Qi clan, meet because of a strange murder case concerning the relationship between the two clans and form a partnership of two people with a huge warmth difference. They work together to find the truth and dissolve the crisis their families are facing.

After a career-ending injury, Taekwondo star Zhiyao falls into gambling and is forced to become a prison administrator, tasked with overseeing the notorious boss Chihuahua under the watchful eye of instructor Jiang Yijie. Amid the harsh, absurd conditions, Zhiyao and his colleagues form bonds of friendship, trust, and love, finding meaning and resilience in their challenging work.
A painful but exciting story of Oh Soo-jae, a cold lawyer who has become empty while pursuing only success, and Gong Chan, a law school student who is not afraid of anything to protect her.

During the 19th year of the Yongle reign, a wave of strange crimes sweeps the capital—demons roam at night, national treasures vanish, and an imperial physician is replaced by an impostor. Jinyiwei officer Tang Ge investigates and uncovers a deadly conspiracy to overthrow the throne. Amid secret rivalries, mistaken identities, Tang Ge must unravel the truth and protect the empire.

Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.
It's 3 minutes for hearers, but a life for the callers. A crime thriller chasing even the slightest sounds to rescue people's lives calling for urgent help.

entries.name: AS - Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty (2022) (CN)

streams.name: AS - Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty (2022) (CN)

metadata.overview: General Lu Lingfeng and Detective Su Wuming uncover supernatural mysteries and hidden conspiracies threatening the empire during Emperor Xuanzong’s reign.

Rebellious heir Li Shang and hometown café owner Li Zi reunite years after their first love faded. As Li Shang struggles to save his family’s fireworks factory and Li Zi builds her live-streaming business, they join forces to preserve the fading art of traditional fireworks. Through setbacks, ambition, and rekindled affection, their shared passion ignites both a cultural revival and a radiant new chapter in their love story.

Two generations of detectives stumble through challenges, unwavering in their pursuit, as they search for a killer in maze-like alleyways, ultimately finding their way out of the dead ends in their own lives.

After her family is killed by her childhood sweetheart, A Mai disguises herself as a man to seek revenge.
